_how: Every statement on the public site that only the owner can vouch for hangs on one entry below.
While `confirmed` is false the site does not say it: the sentence, stat, table row or section is left out or replaced by wording that is true either way.
To publish a fact: check `value` is exactly what you will stand behind (edit it if not), set `confirmed` to true, commit, deploy. No code change.
An entry whose `value` is an empty string stays hidden even when confirmed is true: it needs your words or your number first.
`value: true` means the copy is already written and only needs your yes.
Proposed values came from the old site copy and from earlier working sessions. They are proposals, not facts.
Questions, grouped by how much copy each one unlocks: docs/messaging/owner-questions.md.
